Lid.et:
From Middle High German lit (“lid, cover”), from Old High German hlit, from Proto-West Germanic *hlid.
In the modern sense a shortening of Augenlid. Cognate with Dutch lid (“lid”), English lid, Icelandic hlið.

s: a surname of southern German and Austrian origin
